name: Darkmist Ruins
summary: Perched atop an elevated bluff in northern Feralas, the Darkmist Ruins are the crumbling remains of an ancient Highborne settlement affiliated with the Shen'dralar. Overrun by restless spectral poltergeists, the site sits hemmed in between the Woodpaw gnolls and the sunken city of Eldre'Thalas.

sections.title: A Haunted Haven
sections.body: The Darkmist Ruins crown an upland ridge south of Woodpaw Den, accessible through winding paths climbing up from the Woodpaw Hills or the Ruins of Isildien. Long ago tied to the arcane culture of the Shen'dralar, the estate fell into decay as demonic corruption and tragedy consumed its residents. Today, the overgrown stonework is completely abandoned by the living, haunted instead by agitated Highborne poltergeists drifting amid the broken pillars.

sections.title: The Lingering Dead
sections.body: While the jungle slowly reclaims the white stone courtyards, the restless shades lingering here bear witness to the fall of the ancient night elven aristocracy. Swirling with unresolved magical energy and tormented memories of the Sundering era, the ruins serve as a stark reminder of the hubris that doomed the Highborne of Feralas.

faq.answer: They are the ruins of an ancient Highborne settlement located atop an elevated ridge in northern Feralas, historically tied to the Shen'dralar.

faq.q: How do you reach the ruins?
aliases: how to get to darkmist ruins
faq.answer: The ruins sit on an elevated mountain ridge and can be reached via trails leading up through Woodpaw Den to the north, the Woodpaw Hills to the east, or the borders of the Ruins of Isildien to the west.
The ruins are haunted by restless Highborne poltergeists and lingering apparitions from the ancient night elf civilization.

faq.q: Who were the Highborne that lived here?
faq.answer: The estate was populated by Highborne elves affiliated with the nearby Shen'dralar of Eldre'Thalas, who maintained arcane enclaves throughout the Feralas wilderness prior to their fall.

angles.text: For the night elves of Feathermoon Stronghold, ruins like Darkmist are grim reminders of the reckless arcane hubris and demonic flirtations that brought down their ancient empire.
Mages exploring the Feralas wilds will recognize the distinct structural markers and residual ethereal energy left behind by the Sorcerer-Caste of the Highborne.
